primary_outcome: percentage reduction in rounds to a method-specific shared target
normalization: round gain min-max normalized within method, dataset, and metric
interpretation_boundary: Each method is compared only with its paired random curve because the shared target used to compute round gain is method-specific.
Activation, NTK, and committee gains therefore define separate binary decisions and are never treated as directly comparable utilities.
The aggregate T1x table is excluded because it averages three candidate pools and leaves no independent material or dataset holdout group.
Exact round gains come from the manuscript table; underlying per-round numerical histories and seed-level outcomes were not released.
